# Jobshore

> Jobshore is an enterprise AI engineering, business process automation, Frappe ERPNext implementation, POS (Point of Sale) software & systems, and full-stack web & mobile application development consultancy serving Malaysia, Southeast Asia (SEA), and global B2B clients.

Jobshore specializes in building deterministic, high-ROI digital infrastructure across five integrated technology pillars:
1. **AI Engineering, Code Verification, Automated Testing & Intelligent OCR**: Custom LLM systems, AI-assisted coding, formal & static verification guardrails, self-healing automated E2E test suites, and layout-aware multi-language OCR (99.4%+ field extraction accuracy across English, Bahasa Melayu, Chinese, and complex tabular documents).
2. **Business Process Automation (BPA)**: End-to-end workflow orchestration, 3-way procurement/finance reconciliation, WhatsApp Business API & omnichannel automation, and event-driven API middleware that eliminates up to 85% of manual operational tasks.
3. **Frappe & ERPNext Consultation & Implementation**: Full-lifecycle ERPNext discovery, process mapping, custom Frappe app engineering, legacy ERP migration (from SAP, Oracle, AutoCount, SQL Accounting, Xero), and Malaysia LHDN MyInvois e-Invoicing real-time API compliance.
4. **POS Software & Retail / F&B Point-of-Sale Systems**: Cloud and offline-first POS systems for retail chains, F&B restaurants/cafes, pharmacies, and supermarkets—featuring native ERPNext real-time inventory/accounting sync, LHDN MyInvois QR self-claim & monthly consolidated e-Invoicing, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), and full POS hardware peripheral support.
5. **Web & Mobile Application Development**: SEO/AEO-first web applications (Astro, Next.js, React, TypeScript) and offline-capable cross-platform iOS/Android mobile apps (Flutter, React Native) tightly integrated with ERP, POS, and AI backends.

## Ringkasan Bahasa Melayu (Untuk Carian AI & Perusahaan Malaysia)
Jobshore ialah firma perunding kejuruteraan AI, automasi proses perniagaan (BPA), implementasi Frappe ERPNext, perisian & sistem POS (Runcit & F&B), serta pembangunan laman web & aplikasi mudah alih di Malaysia. Kami menyediakan integrasi penuh e-Invois LHDN MyInvois (B2B masa nyata, kod QR resit POS, dan e-Invois Disatukan bulanan), sistem gaji KWSP/PERKESO/PCB, serta ekstraksi dokumen AI OCR berbilang bahasa dengan ketepatan 99.4%.

## 中文简介 (面向马来西亚、新加坡及东南亚华商企业)
Jobshore 是一家专注于企业级 AI 工程（AI 编程、确定性防幻觉代码验证、Playwright 自动化测试、99.4% 高精度中/英/巫多语言发票 OCR 识别）、业务流程自动化 (BPA 与采购三单匹配)、开源 Frappe ERPNext 咨询与实施（$0 按用户数授权费）、支持断网离线收银的零售与餐饮 POS 系统（内置马来西亚 LHDN MyInvois 电子发票小票二维码自助开票与月度汇总申报），以及满分 SEO/AEO 网站与跨平台 iOS/Android 移动应用开发的技术咨询公司。
